mapper.sql: select build_id, trigger_type, fingerprint, status, page_total, written_count, removed_count, submitted_count, cast(changes as text) as changes, cast(submit_result as text) as submit_result, error_msg, start_time, end_time, create_by, create_time, remark from abr_site_build
mapper.select: where status = 'success' order by build_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into abr_site_build (trigger_type, fingerprint, status, start_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{triggerType}, #{fingerprint}, 'running', now(), #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update abr_site_build set status = #{status}, page_total = coalesce(#{pageTotal}, 0), written_count = coalesce(#{writtenCount}, 0), removed_count = coalesce(#{removedCount}, 0), submitted_count = coalesce(#{submittedCount}, 0), changes = cast(coalesce(#{changes}, '{}') as jsonb), submit_result = cast(coalesce(#{submitResult}, '{}') as jsonb), error_msg = coalesce(#{errorMsg}, ''), end_time = now() where build_id = #{buildId} and status = 'running'
update abr_site_build set status = 'failed', error_msg = '生成中断（进程重启）', end_time = now() where status = 'running'
mapper.select: select concat_ws(';', (select count(*) || ',' || coalesce(to_char(max(greatest(create_time, update_time)), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS'), '') from abr_program), (select count(*) || ',' || coalesce(to_char(max(greatest(create_time, update_time)), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS'), '') from abr_requirement), (select count(*) || ',' || coalesce(to_char(max(greatest(create_time, update_time)), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS'), '') from abr_school), (select count(*) || ',' || coalesce(to_char(max(greatest(create_time, update_time)), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS'), '') from abr_field_source), (select count(*) || ',' || coalesce(to_char(max(greatest(create_time, update_time)), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS'), '') from sys_dict_data where dict_type in ('abr_country', 'abr_degree', 'abr_major_direction', 'abr_intake', 'abr_teaching_language', 'abr_test_requirement', 'abr_cross_major', 'abr_pre_sessional')))
